name: workflow
description: Small helpers for the Claude Code workflow itself, such as skill-activation reminders and worktree setup

worktree_copy_paths.title: Paths to copy into worktrees
worktree_copy_paths.description: Repo-relative paths the worktree gets its own copy of, so edits there stay there. Good for .env and anything else you may tune for one branch. Nothing is carried until you list something here or under the link option. Paths missing from a repo are skipped, so one list works across all your repos.

worktree_link_paths.title: Paths to symlink into worktrees
worktree_link_paths.description: Repo-relative paths the worktree symlinks instead of copying, so it always sees the current version and edits write back to the main checkout. Good for .claude/skills, .claude/settings.json, .claude/settings.local.json and personal notes. A git-ignore pattern matches a symlink only when written without a trailing slash - personal, not personal/ - and the hook tells you when a link lands unignored.
